briefdescription.para: Focused tests for AQL Phase 4 consistency hardening.

detaileddescription.para: Test Coverage: CONS-01..CONS-04: Unified error handling consistency CONS-05..CONS-08: Standardized logging and error tags PERF-01..PERF-04: Performance gate validation

Requirements:
All components share consistent error handling semantics
All error tags follow [COMPONENT:ErrorType] format
All timeout/retry logic is unified and consistent
All resource limits enforce fail-closed behavior
